meta.instruction: Apply each remediation item in the order listed. Each item identifies the file, the specific location, the problem, and the exact change required. Where code is shown, replace the OLD block with the NEW block verbatim. Commit each logical group (same letter prefix) as one atomic commit with the message shown in 'commit_message'.

remediations.title: SVG viewer never opens after Preview — post_run coroutine not awaited
remediations.commit_message: fix(preview): await async post_run so SVG viewer opens after 3dm preview
remediations.description: Inside the quick-actions _make_handler loop, the 'Preview' branch creates a synchronous closure 'post_run' that calls the async function _open_svg_viewer without awaiting it. Additionally, _stream_command calls 'await post_run()' which awaits the synchronous wrapper's return value (None), so the coroutine returned by _open_svg_viewer is created and immediately garbage-collected without running. Fix: make the post_run closure async and await _open_svg_viewer inside it.

if label == "Preview":
                                    model_name = (_opt_model.value or "").strip() or "main"
                                    view = (_opt_view.value or "").strip() or "3sil"

                                    def post_run():
                                        _open_svg_viewer(
                                            project_root,
                                            model_name,
                                            view,
                                            _log_ref[0],
                                            preview_btn_ref[0],
                                        )
change.new:
if label == "Preview":
                                    model_name = (_opt_model.value or "").strip() or "main"
                                    view = (_opt_view.value or "").strip() or "3sil"

                                    async def post_run():
                                        await _open_svg_viewer(
                                            project_root,
                                            model_name,
                                            view,
                                            _log_ref[0],
                                            preview_btn_ref[0],
                                        )

remediations.title: post_run closure captures loop variable — all buttons after 'Preview' trigger SVG viewer
remediations.commit_message: fix(actions): reset post_run to None before Preview branch to avoid loop closure capture bug
remediations.description: The _make_handler factory closes over 'post_run' by name. Because 'post_run' is assigned only in the 'Preview' branch but is not reset on each call to _make_handler, later handler invocations for non-Preview buttons still see the last assigned post_run from the previous iteration. Fix: initialise post_run = None at the top of the handler function body, before the label check, so each invocation is independent.

change.new:

remediations.description: NiceGUI's ui.notify() renders Quasar QNotify toasts that are not injected into an aria-live region. NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver may miss them entirely. Add a helper function _announce(message) that writes to the existing #a11y-live div (injected by the keyboard-shortcut JS block) via ui.run_javascript, and call it alongside every ui.notify() invocation throughout app.py.

"""Push a message to the screen-reader aria-live region in addition to any toast."""
2. For every call in app.py of the form:
Add a call to _announce("some message") immediately before or after the ui.notify() call.
3. In core.py, where the binary-not-found warning is pushed to the output log,
ensure the corresponding UI code in index() also calls _announce() with the same text.
4. Do NOT replace ui.notify() — keep both so sighted users continue to see toasts.

remediations.title: Dialog host div is hidden from assistive technology
remediations.commit_message: a11y: replace zero-size hidden dialog host with AT-accessible visually-hidden container
remediations.description: The _popup_host_ref container uses Tailwind classes 'w-0 h-0 overflow-hidden' which makes the element invisible to both sighted users and AT. Some screen readers inspect parent accessibility trees and suppress dialogs whose ancestors are marked hidden. Replace with a standard visually-hidden pattern that keeps the element in the AT tree.

remediations.title: Browse button triggers hidden file input via JavaScript — AT cannot track focus or announcement

remediations.description: The 'Browse…' button fires document.querySelector('.q-uploader input[type=file]').click() via JavaScript. Hidden inputs triggered this way do not reliably receive focus announcements in NVDA+Firefox or JAWS+Chrome. The file-selected callback updates file_input but the toast (ui.notify) is also unreliable for AT. Additionally, the upload widget's 'Drop a .scad / .stl here' label is not associated with the input via aria-labelledby.
instructions: 1. Keep the existing ui.upload() widget for drag-and-drop support.
2. Remove the separate 'Browse…' ui.button() that calls ui.run_javascript to click the hidden input.
3. Add the prop 'label="Browse for a .scad, .stl, or .3mf file"' directly to the ui.upload() widget.
4. Ensure ui.upload() has 'flat' style so it renders a visible, focusable button.
5. After the upload widget, call _announce() with the selected filename inside handle_upload.
6. Set aria-label on the upload widget to 'Upload model file. Activating this button opens a file chooser.'

- 'Reset View'   → calls JS that resets camera to initial position

remediations.title: Quick Actions uses role=toolbar with aria-orientation=horizontal on a multi-row grid
remediations.commit_message: a11y: replace toolbar role with group role on quick actions grid to fix arrow-key navigation
remediations.description: role='toolbar' with aria-orientation='horizontal' means AT products only allow left/right arrow navigation, but the buttons are arranged in a 3-column grid with multiple rows. AT users cannot navigate to buttons in lower rows with arrow keys. Replace with role='group' which has no arrow-key navigation semantics, leaving Tab navigation intact.
